lessons.title: Pasado simple: -ed
lessons.goal: Cuenta lo que hiciste ayer, la semana pasada o el año pasado
tip: Los verbos regulares forman el pasado añadiendo -ed: work → worked, visit → visited.
En negativas y preguntas se usa «did»: I didn't work, Did you work?
Con «did» el verbo vuelve al infinitivo: «Did you went?» es incorrecto.

phrases.t: What did you do at the weekend?

pair.t: We watched TV last night.

exercises.explain: Ver la tele es «watch TV»: watched.

pair.t: She studied for the exam yesterday.

exercises.explain: study termina en consonante + y: studied.

pair.es: Trabajé en un hotel el año pasado
pair.t: I worked in a hotel last year

exercises.audio: We visited my grandparents last weekend.

pair.es: Visitamos a mis abuelos el fin de semana pasado.

pair.t: Did you go to the party?

exercises.explain: Tras «did» el verbo va en infinitivo: Did you go…?

lessons.title: Pasado irregular
lessons.goal: Domina los verbos irregulares más frecuentes
tip: Irregulares clave: go → went, see → saw, have → had, take → took, make → made, get → got.
«Ago» va después del periodo: two years ago (hace dos años).

phrases.t: I went to the cinema with Marta
We saw a very good film

phrases.t: I arrived late because I missed the bus

lessons.title: Pasado continuo
lessons.goal: Describe acciones que estaban en curso y lo que las interrumpió
tip: was/were + verbo en -ing: I was reading (estaba leyendo).
«When» presenta la acción que interrumpe (pasado simple): I was reading when she called.
«While» acompaña a la acción larga: While I was reading, it started to rain.

phrases.t: I was cooking when you called me
While I was reading, it started to rain
What were you doing at eight?

pair.t: I was reading when she arrived.

exercises.prompt: While we ___ , we saw a deer.

pair.t: While we were walking, we saw a deer.

exercises.explain: «While» + pasado continuo para la acción larga.

lessons.title: Contar una historia
lessons.goal: Ordena un relato y habla de hábitos pasados con «used to»
tip: Conectores de relato: First… Then… After that… Finally…
«Used to» + infinitivo para hábitos del pasado que ya no ocurren: I used to play tennis.
Negativa: didn't use to; pregunta: Did you use to…?

phrases.t: First we had breakfast, then we went out

phrases.es: Solía jugar al tenis cuando era niño
phrases.t: I used to play tennis when I was a child

phrases.es: Al final, todos volvimos a casa
phrases.t: Finally, we all went back home

pair.t: I used to live in Madrid.

options: I used to run in the mornings
I use to ran in the mornings
I am used run in the mornings

pair.t: I used to run in the mornings.

exercises.explain: used to + verbo en infinitivo, siempre.
